title: cerastium arvense subsp. pallasii
intro: Cerastium arvense subsp. pallasii, commonly known as Pallas's mouse-ear or Alpine chickweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium arvense subsp. pallasii include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
